step1_analysis.description: A cascade of three NMOS differential pairs with tail current sources. It likely serves as an input pre-amplifier or limiting amplifier for a 10-Gb/s receiver, amplifying small differential signals to logic levels.

paper_reference.title: OC-192 Transmitter and Receiver in Standard 0.18-m CMOS

Differential_Gain.description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain of the 3-stage amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov. With VBIAS=0.54V, Vth=0.42V, Vov=0.12V. Id_tail = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * 0.12^2 = 19.4uA. Id_branch = 9.7uA. gm = 2*9.7u/0.12 = 161uS. Assuming 20kOhm load resistors added for functionality, gain per stage = gm*R = 3.22 V/V. Total gain = 3.22^3 = 33.4 V/V = 30.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the load resistors which are not present in the netlist and must be added. 20kOhm provides a reasonable gain for testing.

paper_reported.value: 10 Gb/s data rate implies ~7 GHz bandwidth

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * R_load * C_parasitic). With R_load = 20kOhm and C_parasitic ~ 10fF, BW = 1 / (2 * pi * 20k * 10fF) = 795 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The calculated bandwidth is lower than the 10 Gb/s requirement because of the low bias current (0.54V) and large assumed load resistors (20k). In the actual design, smaller loads and higher currents would be used.

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the amplifier stages.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the provided VBIAS of 0.54V. The actual circuit likely uses a higher bias voltage to achieve the 10 Gb/s bandwidth, which would increase power.

sky130_expected.calculation: Max swing is limited by tail current steering through the load resistor. V_swing = Id_tail * R_load = 19.4uA * 20kOhm = 0.388 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Assuming full current steering in the final stage due to the high gain of the preceding stages acting as a limiting amplifier.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the 3-stage differential amplifier. Adds 20kOhm load resistors to VDD to complete the circuit. Measures DC power, AC differential gain, 3-dB bandwidth, and transient output swing.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for 3-stage differential amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM1 N8 VBIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N12 VBIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N1 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 VBIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 INP N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUTP N4 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 OUTN N0 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N4 N10 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N10 INN N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* Load resistors (added to complete the circuit)
R1 VDD N1 20k
R2 VDD N10 20k
R3 VDD N0 20k
R4 VDD N4 20k
R5 VDD OUTP 20k
R6 VDD OUTN 20k

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIAS VBIAS 0 0.54
VINP INP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.05 100MEG 0 0)
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.05 100MEG 0 0)

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 20 1MEG 100G
  let vdiff = v(OUTP) - v(OUTN)
  let gain_mag = mag(vdiff)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1MEG
  let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  tran 0.1n 50n
  meas tran vout_p_max max v(OUTP) from=20n to=50n
  meas tran vout_p_min min v(OUTP) from=20n to=50n
  let vout_p_swing = vout_p_max - vout_p_min
  print vout_p_swing
  
  quit
.endc
.end
